script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.id AS CHAR), 'material_code', i.material_code, 'material_name', i.material_name, 'material_desc', i.material_desc,
       'item_category', i.item_category, 'further_description', i.further_description, 'based_uom', CAST(i.based_uom AS CHAR),
       'based_uom_name', (SELECT bu.uom_name FROM unit_of_measurement bu WHERE bu.id = i.based_uom AND bu.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1),
       'mat_purchase_tax_id', CAST(i.mat_purchase_tax_id AS CHAR), 'is_active', i.is_active,
       'conv', COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(c.`id` AS CHAR), 'alt_qty', c.`alt_qty`, 'alt_uom_id', CAST(c.`alt_uom_id` AS CHAR), 'text_b4j8h211',
		c.`text_b4j8h211`, 'base_qty', c.`base_qty`, 'base_uom_id', CAST(c.`base_uom_id` AS CHAR), 'purchase_unit_price', c.`purchase_unit_price`, 'mat_purchase_tax_id',
		CAST(c.`mat_purchase_tax_id` AS CHAR), 'purchase_max_price', c.`purchase_max_price`, 'over_delivery_tolerance', c.`over_delivery_tolerance`, 'purchase_default_uom',
		c.`purchase_default_uom`, 'over_receive_tolerance', c.`over_receive_tolerance`, 'purchase_tax_percent', c.`purchase_tax_percent`, 'sales_tax_percent', c.`sales_tax_percent`,
		'sales_min_price', c.`sales_min_price`, 'purchase_min_price', c.`purchase_min_price`, 'mat_sales_tax_id', CAST(c.`mat_sales_tax_id` AS CHAR), 'sales_unit_price',
		c.`sales_unit_price`, 'sales_max_price', c.`sales_max_price`, 'min_purchase_qty', c.`min_purchase_qty`, 'sales_default_uom', c.`sales_default_uom`, 'sales_price_1',
		c.`sales_price_1`, 'sales_price_6', c.`sales_price_6`, 'sales_price_2', c.`sales_price_2`, 'sales_price_5', c.`sales_price_5`, 'sales_price_4', c.`sales_price_4`,
		'sales_price_3', c.`sales_price_3`, 'sales_tariff_id', CAST(c.`sales_tariff_id` AS CHAR), 'purchase_tariff_id', CAST(c.`purchase_tariff_id` AS CHAR), 'max_purchase_qty',
		c.`max_purchase_qty`, 'max_sales_qty', c.`max_sales_qty`, 'min_sales_qty', c.`min_sales_qty`, 'item_barcode', c.`item_barcode`, 'uom_name', u.uom_name))
                           OVER (ORDER BY c.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
                           FROM item_mji552rc_sub c LEFT JOIN unit_of_measurement u ON u.id = c.alt_uom_id AND u.is_deleted = 0
                          WHERE c.Item_id = i.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1), JSON_ARRAY()),
       'binds', COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('supplier_id', b.supplier_id, 'item_description', b.item_description))
                            OVER (ORDER BY b.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
                            FROM item_eimnda1q_sub b
                           WHERE b.Item_id = i.id AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.supplier_id = '{{node:code_node_PIguard.data.supplierId}}' LIMIT 1), JSON_ARRAY())) AS j
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PIguard.data.tenantId}}' AND i.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_PIguard.data.organizationId}}' AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.material_code IN (SELECT (t.c COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) FROM JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_PIguard.data.codesSql}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (c VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.c')) t)
 ORDER BY i.id
